summary: Loads and initializes the vehicle graphics scene graph for one vehicle slot. Reads a scene file (validated, then optionally post-processed for collision geometry), resolves the vehicle's root scene node by SLOT%03d name, looks up every visual sub-node (four wheels + spindles, front/rear wings, 8 debris nodes, cockpit, suspension, helmet, arms, body, generic wheel, rain/brake/head/backfire lights), assigns per-wheel audio and disc-glow references, copies the bounding box from the source node, pulls vehicle data and sound-effect handles from global tables, and finally collects tire child nodes into a freshly allocated per-tire array with world-relative offsets. Called by VehgenScnFileLoader (004c6c40).

operations.description: If scene file name a2 passes the file validity check (sub_55B6B0), enter the read-error-reporting path.

When the file is invalid: copy the error string into the local buffer, split the message line via StringSplitLoop against source tag aDDevF119992002_6, and write 'Unable to read %s: %s' to the debug log.

When post-load-setup flag a3 is set: if vertex buffer resources exist for collision geometry (dword_8AFE88), report 'Unable to setup after reading' on failure, run secondary initialization sub_4E2A60(this), and initialize the scoring-grid base sub_4CEF30(&dword_8ACEA0).
Format the scene instance name 'SLOT%03d' into the buffer using the parent object's slot index field obj+0x4894.
Resolve the root scene node by name into this+0x4; on failure log 'Could not find instance %s'.
Manipulate a flag field via FlagFieldBitManipulation(1, 1, 0, 0).
Conditionally set audio parameters for the root scene node (this+0x4).
Set render flag 2048 for the parent object's slot index obj+0x4894.
Compute the bounding box of the root scene node into the source bbox fields this+0x78 (min) and this+0x84 (max).
Toggle visibility of a scene node (argument 0).
Resolve the four wheel node handles (LF 0x144, RF 0x26C, LR 0x394, RR 0x4BC) and four spindle node handles (LF 0x188, RF 0x2B0, LR 0x3D8, RR 0x500) under the root node by their named children.
Loop over the 4 wheel blocks (stride 74 dwords from 0x144): update the physics-audio vector for each wheel node pair.

Loop over the 4 wheel blocks (starting this+0x18C): conditionally set audio parameters for tire and spindle, copy the spindle/tire node pair into the block fields 0x18C..0x1A0 when the spindle is absent, zero the block counters 0x1E0/0x1E4/0x1E8, then scan the two parent nodes' children by camera-distance LOD ordering for a node matching the 'disc glow' name and store the first match into 0x1E0 and the second into 0x1E4.
Resolve the front wing (0x5E4) and rear wing (0x628) nodes under the root and set their audio parameters.
Loop 8 times (stride 17 dwords from 0x66C): format 'DEBRIS%d', resolve the debris node by that name under the root, and set its audio parameters.

Resolve the cockpit 0x88C, suspension 0x890, helmet 0x894, arms 0x898, body 0x89C, generic wheel 0x8A0, rain light 0x8A4, brake light 0x8A8, headlight 0x8AC and backfire 0x8B0 nodes under the root scene node.
Zero this+0x930 then, if the helmet node (0x894) exists, query three float fields from it into this+0x930.
Run vertex-clustering LOD grouping on the whole vehicle object, then the secondary post-processing sub_4E3360(this).
Copy the source bounding box from this+0x78..0x8C into the working bbox fields this+0x60 (min X/Y/Z) .. this+0x74 (max X/Y/Z).
Loop over the 4 wheel blocks (stride 74 dwords): expand the working bounding box with each tire (0x144, 0x26C, 0x394, 0x4BC) and spindle (0x188, 0x2B0, 0x3D8, 0x500) node's box when present.
Expand the working bounding box with the front wing (0x5E4) and rear wing (0x628) nodes when present.
Zero this+0x8B4; if the arms node (0x898) exists, count its children, cap the count at 2 into this+0x8B4, and store the first child handles into the matched-node region this+0x8C4.
Guarded by this+0x8B4 > 0: zero the matched count 0x8C0, then for each collected child run a wide-string comparison against the 'catsteer' name and record matches into this+0x8C4, incrementing 0x8C0.

Index the global vehicle array dword_8AC394 by the parent object's slot obj+0x4898 (stride 1060 dwords): copy fields into this+0x8E8..0x8FC and this+0x918..0x92C, zero the slots 0x900..0x914 and 0x950, and copy three trailing fields into 0x958/0x95C/0x960.

Loop over the 4 wheel blocks (stride 296 bytes from 0x144): query three float fields, recompute the bounding box, derive a scaled radius, zero field 0x1EC, and run sub_5506A0(0,0,0) for each tire node.
Zero the block 0x934..0x948 (including the word write at 0x948) and 0x950, reset the UI timer/tween with 0.0, and zero the effect field 0xB6C.

Zero the three global sound-effect handles 0x008AD3EC/0x008AD3F0/0x008AD3F4; if collision geometry dword_8AFE88 yields a value, load tread sound handles by the 'tread', 'treadmed' and 'treadlow' names.

Write the state byte flags 0x96C=1, 0x96D=1, 0x975=0, 0x976=1, 0x977=0, 0x978=1, 0x979=0, set 0x970 to 1.0f, and compute the per-tire brightness factor 0x97C from a weather-noise table value scaled and offset.
Copy the status field from global instance dword_5EA560 to the parent slot obj+0x4894.

Walk the root node's child list starting from the child at dword+17, copying each child's self-relative name; children matching the vehicle scene tag and the 'tire' name are appended to the local scratch array, bumping the tire count this+0x2BD0 up to a cap of 8.
If the collected tire count this+0x2BD0 is positive, allocate the tire data array (20 bytes per tire) via operator new into this+0x2BD4.

Fill the allocated tire array this+0x2BD4: classify each tire node by name against 'rftire'/'lrtire'/'rrtire' into an index, store the node handle and index, query three float fields, and write world-relative offsets referenced from the first wheel block (0x144).
Return the collected tire count (this+0x2BD0).
